entries.title: Ilyra and the Borrowed Dawn
entries.purpose: Give warmth without exhausting the protector.
entries.story: A storm has extinguished the harbor lamps. Ilyra offers stored daylight; a child offers a cup in return.
entries.cost: Her shell-feathers lose their warmth and become grey. She cannot generate heat from nothing.
entries.gameMechanic: Players shelter the lamp while another restores her feather stores.
entries.prompt: Create one extraordinary original Arcanea fantasy key art, landscape 16:9, titled in metadata only 'Ilyra and the Borrowed Dawn'. No text in image. A tender monumental winged female guardian with dark braided hair, adult, weathered ivory linen and a restrained copper clasp, kneels at the edge of a saltwater fishing village. Her wings are beautifully structured pale feathers threaded with translucent oyster-shell lamellae; one wing curves into an architectural shelter over a small fisher family tending an ordinary oil lamp. She gives the last warmth stored in her feathers to restart the lamp; the outermost feathers visibly turn matte cool grey, a subtle cost. Specific emotionally legible gesture: her open hand hovers beside the lamp while a child, clothed in coral wool, offers her a modest terracotta cup. Not a battle, no random magical glyphs, no halo ornaments. Composition: camera very low beside the wet basalt steps, 28mm cinematic wide lens, foreground ropes and tide pool reflecting tiny warm lamp, guardian in right two thirds, left third quiet deep slate sea for optional web heading. Dramatic but gentle chiaroscuro, sunrise withheld behind blue storm clouds, tiny warm apricot light on faces, pearl-grey wings with exquisite restrained material detail. Renaissance tonal discipline translated into an original contemporary fantasy painting with physically believable anatomy, tactile brushwork, atmospheric perspective and lucid game cinematic staging. No imitation of any specific artwork, artist or franchise. Warmth, dignity, beautiful humanity, enormous power expressed through care. High fidelity, sophisticated painted realism, no plastic skin, no sparkling clutter, no gold armor, no teal purple sci-fi.
entries.review: Strong tenderness and shelter silhouette; the depleted feather edge is too subtle.
entries.nextIteration: Move to child eye height and enlarge the cold feather edge.
entries.alt: A winged woman shelters a family and warms a harbor lamp while a child offers her a cup.

entries.title: The Offered Cup
entries.purpose: Make the recipient an active participant.
entries.story: The child sees the price of the gift and responds with care.
entries.cost: A visible dark edge records the warmth Ilyra has already spent.
entries.gameMechanic: Return care to restore capacity; protection is a shared resource.
entries.prompt: Create a second shot in the SAME original Arcanea scene, preserve this adult dark-braided woman Ilyra's face, oyster-shell layered wings, ivory linen clothing, copper clasp, warm lamp and coral-clad child. Change composition to an intimate cinematic vertical 4:5 portrait, medium close shot at the child's eye height: Ilyra's expressive tired kind face in profile occupies upper right, the child offers a chipped terracotta cup in lower left, both hands clearly separated and anatomically correct, lamp between them. MOST IMPORTANT narrative refinement: across the frame curves a single wing with unmistakable transition from warm nacre near the lamp to cold charcoal-grey, desaturated and cracked shell lamellae at the outer edge. That fading edge must be clearly legible and beautiful, showing the cost of giving warmth. A tiny warm reflection in her eye. Background village reduced to soft shadow, no castle, no glitter, no extra characters, no text. Finest painterly cinema, subtle brush texture instead of hyperreal plastic, warm human connection, quiet wonder, strong compositional hierarchy. This is a new angle of the existing character, not another generic angel.
entries.review: Fading shell feathers read clearly and the cup creates a reciprocal gesture; still resembles familiar angel imagery.
entries.nextIteration: For the next identity sheet, strengthen the oyster-shell joints and asymmetrical copper fastener.
entries.alt: A child offers a terracotta cup to Ilyra beneath a wing whose outer feathers have turned grey.

entries.title: The Orchard of Returning Rain
entries.purpose: Make environment, creature and cooperative action one system.
entries.story: A stone crane carries irrigation across an orchard. Three travelers repair its water route.
entries.cost: One stored rain supply serves the whole orchard; moving water to one terrace delays another.
entries.gameMechanic: Sluice operator, route repairer and planter must coordinate.
entries.prompt: One original Arcanea fantasy game environment key art, panoramic landscape 16:9, 'The Orchard of Returning Rain', no lettering. Elevated three-quarter camera from a balcony at about 35 degrees down, unusually clear spatial storytelling suitable as a playable cooperative exploration level. At dawn an immense gentle creature shaped like a sleeping white stone crane rests across a terraced orchard, folded articulated wings form elegant stepped aqueducts in cream limestone with moss seams and copper rain cups. Its long neck curls protectively around an old pear tree. It is a living sanctuary and ordinary orchard workers care for it. Three small travelers wearing distinct rust red, cream and sage coats cooperate: one opens a sluice at left foreground, one holds a rain cup midway on the crane's wing, one plants a sapling by a dry cistern at right. A SINGLE unmistakable bright silver stream visibly travels along the wing aqueduct from left foreground through center to a blue ceramic basin at right; branches remain dry, showing constrained water. Spatial progression clearly legible in three terraces: entry kitchen garden, wing aqueduct puzzle, sleeping bird head sanctuary; traversable ochre paths and bridges, no inaccessible floating islands, no random UI. Warm apricot sunlight through soft cloud, mint pear foliage, cream stone, copper accents, powder blue shallow water, tiny domestic details and birds conveying life and scale. Painterly premium game production concept with crisp silhouette and atmospheric distance, believable architecture, sophisticated composition, contemporary original design with delicate fine-art surface. Wonder, kindness, playfulness and ancient intelligence. NO fortress, no ornate gold armor, no cosmic purple, no copied game or artist style, no text, no labels. Focus on the readable route and beautiful benevolent creature silhouette.
entries.review: Distinct silhouette and three activity zones; water direction and path connectivity need a greybox test.
entries.nextIteration: Reverse the water source to the high basin and prove a continuous downhill route in a top-down plan.
entries.alt: A vast stone crane forms an orchard aqueduct while three travelers tend water, channels and seedlings.

sources.takeaway: Protective figures have contextual roles; do not collapse them into Christian angels.

sources.title: National Gallery — Lippi, The Annunciation
